definitions.servo_command_deg: The labelled g command used during capture.
definitions.optical_offset_deg: Signed angle from the camera optical axis to the YOLO V8 bounding-box centre ray in the single-axis camera plane; positive is downward in the image.
definitions.legacy_mechanical_horizontal_deg: optical_offset_deg plus the configured camera mounting tilt; retained as a separate legacy field.

mechanical_transmission.assumption: 40-tooth servo pinion externally meshes with the 48-tooth driven gear; rotation direction is reversed.
mechanical_transmission.note: Do not multiply this ratio into the empirical optical-angle equation again. Absolute driven-gear angle still requires a mechanical zero reference.

runtime_anchor.reason: The real-time program computes angles from the YOLO bounding-box centre, so its empirical fit must use the same anchor.

fit.note: Fit residual measures consistency of the YOLO V8 anchor within this recording; it is not an absolute real-world angle accuracy claim.

excluded.-30: foam block clipped by the bottom image boundary
excluded.-35: foam block clipped by the bottom image boundary
excluded.-40: foam block touches the bottom image boundary
excluded.-55: YOLO V8 produced no usable target box in the representative hold frame
excluded.-100: foam block is outside the image
